title: Why Women's College Basketball Is Catching Up Fast
hook: That year, the women's NCAA final out-drew the men's, and the money is following.
closing: Women's basketball turned a bigger crowd into bigger media money.
question: Did you watch the women's final?

segments.say: The women's basketball championship final drew 18.9 million viewers, edging out that year's men's final.
Attendance at the women's tournament climbed to 2.37 million, well up from recent years.
Media rights for the women's game jumped to 200 million dollars a year, more than three times the old deal.
